Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)

Popular among netrunners who rely on speedy RAM recovery. On that front, the overclocked Biotech coprocessors easily get the job done.

Neuroport Cyberdeck Port Operating System. The Neuroport Cyberdeck Port can now only accept a Biotech Mk.4 Cyberdeck, one of which is provided with purchase of this Operating System.

The Biotech Mk. 4 is a Cyberdeck with 5 Slots that can install Programs or Hardware. Once per Round, when failing to apply a DV10 or higher Quickhack with this Cyberdeck, if the user’s Interface Check was within 2 or less of the Quickhack’s DV, they can immediately spend a NET Action (if they have any remaining) to attempt the Quickhack again at a -1 penalty to their Interface Check to do so.

Slots: 5

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
